subject: Taxes
title: The American Tax Identity
description: Learn The American Tax Identity in one minute.

hook.text: America was born from a tax revolt. 'No taxation without representation' is the founding phrase.

buildup.text: From the Boston Tea Party to the Tea Party movement, tax resistance has shaped elections, protests.

discovery.text: Americans are unique among wealthy nations in viewing taxes as broadly illegitimate.

twist.text: Yet Americans pay less in total tax than citizens of most peer nations.

climax.text: American tax identity isn't about rates—it's about revolutionary narrative.

punchline.text: Born from a tax revolt. Americans feel overtaxed at below-average rates.

quiz.question: How do US tax rates compare to other wealthy nations?
options: Below average, despite Americans feeling overtaxed
